title.narrative: Hatua Zaidi – Deepening Citizen Power for Accountable Governance

description.narrative: Hatua Zaidi, meaning "Next Steps" in Swahili, is a continuation of the progress made in the previous phase of the Hatua ya Wananchi initiative in Nandi County. Building on the strong foundation already established, the project seeks to take citizen engagement and government accountability to the next level. This phase aims to deepen the implementation of the Nandi County Equitable Development Act, 2023, which provides a framework for fair and transparent resource allocation. In the earlier phase, a simplified version of the Act was developed to help ordinary citizens understand its content. Now, to make it even more accessible, this version will be translated into Swahili. This step is especially important for rural and marginalized communities who often face language barriers. To raise further awareness, the project will also roll out a series of local radio talk shows, using local languages to sensitize citizens on their rights, roles, and how they can engage with the Act to shape development in their communities.
